findings.title: Mobile agent memory points at Expo v52 docs while the app runs Expo 54
findings.impact: Every agent session working on mobile is directed two SDK majors behind the installed one, so generated code targets deprecated APIs; the exact failure mode the file was written to prevent.
findings.fix: Point the URL at the unversioned current-docs redirect (or v54) and add a one-line CI grep that fails when the AGENTS.md version string disagrees with the expo dependency range.

strengths.title: Tool-native instruction files redirect instead of duplicating
